title: CobbleVille
body:
This is the official modpack for the CobbleVille Server. A vibrant, community-driven world powered by Cobblemon and built for trainers who want more than just survival.

Explore vast biomes, build your dream town, and catch Pokémon across a living, player-shaped world. Whether you’re aiming to become a competitive battler, a dedicated breeder, a master collector, or a town-building legend, CobbleVille gives you the tools and performance to do it all.

✨ **Features**

🟢 Cobblemon-powered gameplay with immersive Pokémon mechanics

🏙️ Towny-style community focus — build, trade, and grow together

⚔️ Competitive battling & training

🌎 Exploration-enhancing mods for a rich world experience

⚡ Optimized for smooth multiplayer performance

🛠️ Quality-of-life improvements without straying from the Cobblemon experience

**Catch. Build. Battle. Belong.**
